remarks: Your dream home is here!  Panoramic sunset views, exceptional privacy, vaulted ceilings creating a wonderful sense of openness, and extensive modern upgrades highlight this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Laguna Niguel home. All-new dual pained windows, new flooring, new A/C, and a tankless water heater all installed to enhance the comfort and appeal. The private backyard features a gas fire pit, perfect for outdoor entertaining. Enjoy full access to "The Club at Rancho Niguel, " offering an indoor gym, swimming pool, dedicated pickleball courts, tennis, basketball, sports fields, playgrounds, and more.
